title: Month-end receipt matching: how the pilot works
description:
What you send and what you get back: the receipt and invoice matching pilot, for bookkeeping at small businesses and for bookkeepers.

Receipt and Invoice Match Review: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#bookkeeping #monthend

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/receipt-invoice-matching?src=youtube&utm_campaign=receipt-matching-how-it-works
narration: How the receipt and invoice matching pilot works.
You send a month of bank or card transactions, and your receipts and invoices as an export or a spreadsheet.
You get matched pairs, and every exception explained, with the question your bookkeeper needs to decide.
No tax advice, no decisions about how anything is treated, and no contact with your vendors.
One month, up to 300 transactions. The price and terms are on the page.
